The BASIC programming language was origi.why: Rarely stated. Every exact form of the direct fact tried is absent from Dolma. The BASIC article states where it was created by college ("at Dartmouth College"), and names New Hampshire only through the 2019 historical marker in Hanover and a citation's place of publication; the Dartmouth BASIC article does not name the state. It follows from BASIC being developed at Dartmouth and Dartmouth being in Hanover, New Hampshire. Not very_likely: BASIC co-occurs with "Hanover, New Hampshire" a few hundred times, though mostly through Dartmouth's address. The verifier's extra searches (address forms such as 'BASIC was developed at Dartmouth College in Hanover', 'in New Hampshire': 0) found the direct fact only in the 2019 marker coverage ('birthplace of BASIC', 16 hits), so the rating stays likely.
